Latin word

aliēnus

aliēnus, aliēna, aliēnum (+ dat.)

adjective

unsuitable, bad (for someone); other people’s, someone else’s; out of place, unsuitable (to something); foreign to, out of place in, irrelevant to; belonging to another; strange, foreign

In this lexicon

  • bad for you

    also used · classical · Traupman 93

  • other

    also used · classical · Publil. Sent. A 28: Aliēna nōbīs, nostra plūs aliīs placent.

  • out of place

    the recommended word · classical · Nep. Milt. 6.1: nōn aliēnum vidētur, quāle praemium Miltiadī sit tribūtum, docēre (Lewis & Short); Cic. de Or. 2.9: hoc aliēnum est (Lewis & Short s.v. aliquī); Traupman 105: if it is not out of place, nisi aliēnum est

  • relevant

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. relevant

  • strange

    also used · classical · Aug. Civ. 19.7: quam cum homine aliēnō
